Your organisation travels with you

Kraal Code gives authorised people controlled access from a laptop at headquarters, a phone in the field, a tablet in a warehouse, or a home office in another city. Identity, permissions, and auditability travel with every action.

From a laptop at headquarters

Full operational access for finance, approvals, reporting, and administration. Run month-end close, manage inventory, process payroll, and generate reports from your primary office.

  • Complete module access
  • Multi-tab workflows
  • Full reporting and analytics
  • Administration and configuration

From a phone in the field

Record transactions, check stock, approve requests, submit reports, and capture attendance from wherever work takes you. Responsive web access works on any modern mobile browser.

  • Transaction recording
  • Stock level checks
  • Approval workflows
  • Attendance capture

From a home office or remote location

Coordinate projects, manage teams, and maintain visibility across the organisation without being in the same building. Cross-border collaboration with the same controls as headquarters.

  • Project coordination
  • Team management
  • Cross-branch visibility
  • Secure remote access

How controlled access works

Identity

Every user has a verified identity. Two-factor authentication and biometric login protect account access. Sessions are bound to the authenticated user.

Permissions

Role-based access controls what each user can see and do. Branch restrictions limit visibility to authorised locations. Approval limits control financial authority.

Auditability

Every action is recorded — who did what, from where, when. The immutable audit trail works identically whether the user is at headquarters or on a phone in the field.

Session Security

HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies for web sessions. JWT tokens with 15-minute expiry for mobile. Account lockout after 5 failed attempts.
